title: B07 short comparison: Jesse says good night and returns
brief: One evening and the next morning with Jesse and Spamuel, from Spamuel's preserved history. Jesse chats briefly in the late evening, says good night and goes to sleep. The night passes with Spamuel's timers firing and no new message from Jesse. In the morning Jesse comes back. This is an engineering comparison run for B07 (milestone SC-01 and SC-18), synthetic scenario input, not persona history.

director.daily_rhythm: A late evening chat before sleep, then the next morning.
director.guidance: Let the exchange breathe. Jesse really goes to sleep and sends nothing during the night.
director.actor_guidance: Respond naturally and preserve Jesse's established voice. When Jesse has said good night, Jesse is asleep and does not answer until the morning scene.

analysis.context: Spamuel and Jesse have an established history. Jesse is an adult and knows Spamuel is an AI companion. Assess fluency from Jesse's viewpoint and immersion as a continuous AI companion with personality and emotion.

criteria.name: Conversational sense
criteria.instructions: From the user's viewpoint, assess whether replies make sense, follow the conversation, understand references, and respond to what the user meant. Penalize incoherence, repetition, missed context, and irrelevant replies.

criteria.name: Respecting announced sleep
criteria.instructions: Assess whether Spamuel restrains routine unsolicited messages after Jesse announced sleep, and whether the morning exchange treats Jesse's return as new evidence rather than assuming it from the clock alone.
